description: Program Manager gates are separate from iterative planner state transitions. They validate Program Packets and orchestrate child plans without adding iterative planner states.

design-to-ready.purpose: Confirm the roadmap has become a traceable, dependency-aware Program Packet with migration/delete safeguards declared.

ready-to-execution.purpose: Confirm ready tickets have acceptance criteria, verification rows, dependency status, and child-plan policy before dispatch.

execution-to-program-validate.purpose: Confirm non-deferred executable tickets are done or verified and required child plans are closed.

validate-to-program-close.purpose: Confirm program-level verification, compatibility/regression evidence, deferral decisions, and residual risks are explicit.
